text:
maya: FYI customer AcmeCorp (ticket #3421) reports CSV export returns an empty file after applying segmentation + datepicker filters. They see a 200 from our export job but the downloaded CSV is 0 bytes. Repro steps below and attached sample export_id: exp-9d2f. Can someone triage? :eyes:

maya: Repro steps from the customer:
1) Console -> Analytics -> select segmentation = "user.country" and add a free-text segment filter (e.g. "country: United Kingdom")
2) Date range = last 90 days (custom range)
3) Click Export -> CSV (Download)
4) Downloaded file is empty, size 0 bytes. They also tried Export -> S3 and saw a 0 byte object.

aj: Thanks — can you paste the export job id and copy of the response from the /exports endpoint? Also tenant id and browser (they tried Chrome/Win and Safari/Mac).

maya: export id exp-9d2f, tenant acme-corp, browsers Chrome 118 / Safari 16. They attached network HAR showing response content-length: 0. Console shows: "GET /v1/exports/exp-9d2f/download 200 OK, content-length: 0"

leo: I'll try repro locally. Quick thought: segmentation free-text filters get URL-encoded and we had a bug where plus signs and percent-encoding in query params caused the export worker to short-circuit the query builder. Could be truncating resultset before streaming CSV.

leo: Repro attempt in staging (commands):
```
# trigger export job
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"range":"last_90_days","segmentation":{"field":"user.country","filter":"country: United Kingdom"},"format":"csv"}' https://staging.redwood.run/v1/exports
# poll status
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.redwood.run/v1/exports/exp-9d2f/status
```
Status returned: {"status":"completed","s3_object":"s3://redwood-exports/exp-9d2f.csv","bytes":0}

leo: Confirmed: export worker wrote 0 bytes to S3 when segmentation.filter contains unescaped colon + space combo. Investigating query plan. :bug:

sophie: Could this be related to CSV encoding / BOM causing Excel to show blank? The customer also said opening in Excel shows empty sheet. But bytes=0 on S3 means empty file, not Excel display issue.

aj: Good call. If bytes=0 that's server-side. Any errors in worker logs? leo, can you paste recent logs around the job?

leo: Logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T14:22:33Z] export-worker: start job exp-9d2f tenant=acme-corp
[2026-03-15T14:22:34Z] export-worker: build query -> segmentation.filter="country: United Kingdom"
[2026-03-15T14:22:35Z] query-runner: translated filter -> WHERE country = NULL -- (bug: parsing returned null)
[2026-03-15T14:22:35Z] query-runner: resultset rows=0
[2026-03-15T14:22:35Z] csv-writer: streaming 0 rows, wrote 0 bytes
[2026-03-15T14:22:35Z] export-worker: complete job exp-9d2f, bytes=0
```

leo: The parser returns NULL when free-text includes colon+space; looks like our tokenizer treats ": " as operator and then mis-parses country tokens. I'll open a small patch to normalize whitespace and escape colons in segmentation filters.

maya: Customer asked for a workaround — suggested they use the segmentation dropdown pre-built country filter instead of free-text. They said they need free-text though. Any fast mitigation?

aj: Can we deploy a hotfix to the export worker to fallback to raw query when parser fails (i.e., avoid returning NULL) and write out full CSV (even if unsegmented) while we fix parser? That would at least produce non-empty file so customer can get data.

leo: I can push a hotfix: if parser returns null, treat filter as literal string and do LIKE '%United Kingdom%'. Quick PR and rollbackable. Will tag as P1 for customer impact.

sophie: QA: add an automated test for filters with punctuation and ensure CSV writer handles empty result gracefully and records failure reason in job metadata (we currently only set bytes).

maya: I'll update the ticket with repro, workaround (use dropdown), and ETA for hotfix (~2-3 hours). Customer is requesting expedited help.

export-bot: Deployment scheduled: export-worker-hotfix -> canary at 2026-03-15T17:10:00Z

aj: Thanks team. After canary, follow-up plan: monitor export job success rate for tenant acme-corp (compare last 24h success-> bytes>0). Also add an alert if export bytes=0 for >3 jobs in 1h for any tenant.

maya: Sounds good — I'll leave ticket pending and notify customer when canary is live. :thumbsup:
